questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT a reason for electroplating an object?

options.text: To use a cheap metal underneath an expensive metal coating

questions.explanation: Electroplating is used to improve appearance, protect against corrosion, provide a harder surface, and save costs by using a cheap base metal with a thin expensive metal coating. However, electroplating adds a layer of metal to the object, so it does not make the object lighter.
